card.name: Skipping a missed dose
card.fires_on: The word skip (or skipped) and the dose right after it, in missed-dose instructions that say to skip the dose once a time limit has passed. Also fires on 'use' after 'concomitant'.

modes.label: Skip the missed dose
modes.description: The verb skip/skipped, or the word dose after it, in instructions for a dose missed past a time limit.
modes.example: After more than 9 hours,<< skip>> the dose for that day.

modes.label: Concomitant use
modes.description: The word use after 'concomitant' in interaction advice about weighing benefits and risks.
modes.example: Consider the benefits and risks of concomitant<< use>>. ( 7 )

card.writes: It pushes toward adverbs of careful or proper handling (duly, carefully, securely), which suggests little direct link to the skip wording.
card.plain: It lights up on the instruction to skip a missed dose when too much time has passed.
